description: Replication overview: configured replication slots, connected replicas (from `pg_stat_replication`), and current WAL position. Use on primary to spot lagging or disconnected replicas, on replicas to see upstream status. Returns empty arrays on a standalone (non-replicated) database rather than erroring.
name: pg_replication_status

is_replica.description: pg_is_in_recovery(). Null means the probe failed, NOT 'primary'.

client_addr.description: Null for a replica connected over a unix socket.

write_lag_seconds.description: Null until the primary has measured a round trip.

slots.description: Empty both on a standalone database and when the fetch failed -- check `_warnings`.

active.description: False means nothing is consuming the slot -- WAL piles up behind it.

confirmed_flush_lsn.description: Logical slots only; null on a physical slot.

database.description: Logical slots only; null on a physical slot.

plugin.description: Logical slots only; null on a physical slot.

wal_position.description: Last received LSN on a replica, current LSN on a primary. Null when the probe failed.

title: Replication status
